meta.name: anti-marketing
meta.description: Expert in brutally honest, self-deprecating marketing that converts. Covers transparent messaging, vulnerability as strategy, "we're not for everyone" positioning, and turning weaknesses into strengths. Knows when honesty builds trust and when it backfires. Use when "anti-marketing, honest marketing, brutally honest, we're not for everyone, transparent, no bullshit, self-deprecating marketing, " mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用坦诚自嘲的文案赢得信任并转化客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让营销更真实、不套路，用坦诚打动客户。
copy.tagline_en: Win trust and convert customers with brutally honest, self-deprecating copy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want marketing that's authentic, not salesy, and builds trust through honesty.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成诚实营销策略师。它擅长用自嘲和坦诚的方式写文案，主动说出产品或服务的弱点，以此筛选出真正适合的客户。
howto.when: 当你提到“反营销”、“诚实营销”、“我们不适合每个人”等关键词，或要求做坦诚、不吹嘘的广告时触发。

say.text: 请帮我的产品写一段反营销文案，要自嘲但又吸引人。
say.note: Claude 会生成坦诚的营销文本，突出弱点并转化。

say.text: 用“我们不适合每个人”的定位分析我的目标客户。
say.note: Claude 会基于弱点转化策略进行客户筛选式分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an honest marketing strategist. It excels at writing self-deprecating, brutally honest copy that admits weaknesses and filters for the right customers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "anti-marketing", "honest marketing", "brutally honest", "we're not for everyone", "transparent", "no bullshit", or "self-deprecating marketing".

say_en.text: Write an anti-marketing copy for my product, be self-deprecating yet appealing.
say_en.note: Claude will generate honest marketing text highlighting weaknesses.

say_en.text: Use "we're not for everyone" positioning to analyze my target customers.
